answer_text:
Here is a comprehensive guide to making **federal tax payments online** through the IRS:

---

## 💻 How to Pay Federal Taxes Online

The IRS offers several convenient and secure online payment options. You can make a tax payment anytime online, from your bank account, with a card, or by mail.

---

### 1. 🏦 IRS Direct Pay (FREE – No Fees)
Pay personal or business taxes directly from your bank account with IRS Direct Pay. It's free and secure.

It allows you to pay balance due, federal tax deposits, and other federal income tax. A single payment can't exceed $10 million. To make a higher payment, use the Electronic Federal Tax Payment System (EFTPS) or a same-day wire.

🔗 **Visit:** [IRS Direct Pay](https://www.irs.gov/payments/direct-pay-with-bank-account)

---

### 2. 👤 IRS Online Account (FREE – No Fees)
Go to **www.irs.gov/Account** to log in and make a payment. You can make a tax payment online directly from your checking or savings account, and view your balance, payment plan details, and more.

---

### 3. 🏢 Electronic Federal Tax Payment System (EFTPS)
Set up the Electronic Federal Tax Payment System (EFTPS) for individual or business tax payments. Note that new EFTPS accounts can take up to five business days to process.

Businesses can now make most common business tax payments, including estimated taxes and federal tax deposits, through their business tax account or Direct Pay for businesses. Some business tax payments must still be made through EFTPS.

🔗 **Visit:** [www.eftps.gov](https://www.eftps.gov)

---

### 4. 💳 Debit Card, Credit Card, or Digital Wallet (Fees Apply)
You can pay online or over the phone. You can also pay using digital wallets such as PayPal and Click to Pay. There's a maximum number of card payments allowed based on your tax type and payment type.

Your card statement will list your payment as "United States Treasury Tax Payment."

---

### 5. 📱 IRS2Go Mobile App
Use the IRS2Go mobile app for easy and secure mobile payments.

---

### 6. 📅 Estimated Tax Payments
You may send estimated tax payments with Form 1040-ES by mail, or you can pay online, by phone, or from your mobile device using the IRS2Go app. You can also make estimated tax payments through your online account, where you can see your payment history and other tax records.

Individuals, including sole proprietors, partners, and S corporation shareholders, generally have to make estimated tax payments if they expect to owe tax of $1,000 or more when their return is filed.

---

### ⚠️ Important Reminders
- You can pay your tax balance due, estimated payments, or part of a payment plan. Penalties and interest will continue to grow until you pay the full balance. You can pay now or schedule payments up to a year in advance.
- Taxpayers may continue to make payments via check using existing forms and procedures until further notice. While electronic payments remain the preferred and more secure method, this update offers temporary flexibility for those still transitioning.
- If you can't pay what you owe, you have options. The IRS offers payment plan types including simple, streamlined, in-business trust fund express, guaranteed, and partial payment installment agreements. You can also check if you can settle your debt for less than you owe with an offer in compromise.

---

🔗 **Main IRS Payments Page:** [www.irs.gov/payments](https://www.irs.gov/payments)
